raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Dense MHA and MLA host pools currently use the same storage keys across host memory layouts. With L3 caching enabled, restarting with `page_first` after writing pages with `layer_first`, while retaining the same model, rank configuration, page size, and storage directory, lets a matching prefix reuse incompatible KV pages. The file backend accepts these pages because their byte counts are equal.

On an NVIDIA L20 with Qwen3-0.6B, three requests each reported a 240-token storage hit after this layout change and produced different token sequences from the cold-cache control. A GPU page round-trip reproduced the incorrect KV values for both MHA and MLA.

## Modifications

- Add layout-specific `storage_format_tag` values to the dense MHA and MLA host pools, using the existing storage model-name tagging path.
- Keep `layer_first` and `page_first_direct` in the same namespace because their flattened page byte order is identical.
- Add file-backend regression tests for compatible and incompatible layout pairs, including MHA `page_head`, and for untagged legacy pages.

Existing untagged MHA/MLA L3 entries will miss after this change, even if the host layout is unchanged. The cache must warm again under the new keys. Existing entries are not deleted or migrated.

## Accuracy Tests

CPU regressions: **65 tests and 37 subtests passed**.

```bash
python -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_hicache_storage_format_tag.py \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_mem_pool_host.py \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_hicache_file_lru_unit.py \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_scheduler_hicache_attach.py
```

The new regression cases produce 16 failing subtests on the unmodified base. The storage-format test also passes when executed directly, as in registered CI.

Manual validation on one NVIDIA L20, using the file backend:

- **GPU page round-trip:** actual device-to-host and host-to-device transfers for MHA and MLA. All four incompatible `layer_first`/`page_first` cases now miss. All four same-layout cases restore every element exactly.
- **Qwen3-0.6B:** three 253-token prompts, 16 generated tokens each, TP=1, Triton attention, CUDA graphs disabled, `buffer_only`, `write_through`, and page size 16. After switching layouts, all three requests miss the incompatible entries and match the cold-cache outputs token for token. A subsequent same-layout run hits 240 tokens per request and matches the unmodified same-layout warm-cache control token for token.

GPU transfer validation covers `layer_first` and `page_first`. The `page_first_direct` and `page_head` cases are covered by CPU page-format tests. MLA validation covers GPU page transfers; the full-model run uses Qwen3-0.6B. Other storage backends were not exercised.

Local coverage collection crashed during imports on both the unmodified base and patched source, so no coverage percentage is reported.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not measured. This change separates incompatible cache entries; it does not change transfer kernels.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Add focused, registered unit tests.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.
- [x] I have performed a self-review of my own code.

@@ -129,6 +129,12 @@ class MHATokenToKVPoolHost(HostKVCache):
 
     _transfer_device: torch.device
 
+    @property
+    def storage_format_tag(self) -> str:
+        # These layouts flatten a page in the same layer/token/head order.
+        layout = "layer_first" if self.layout == "page_first_direct" else self.layout
+        return f"mha-{layout}-v1"
+
     def __init__(
         self,
         device_pool: MHATokenToKVPool,

@@ -68,6 +68,12 @@ class MLATokenToKVPoolHost(HiSparseHostPoolMixin, HostKVCache):
 
     _transfer_device: torch.device
 
+    @property
+    def storage_format_tag(self) -> str:
+        # page_first_direct adds a singleton page axis to layer_first pages.
+        layout = "layer_first" if self.layout == "page_first_direct" else self.layout
+        return f"mla-{layout}-v1"
+
     def __init__(
         self,
         device_pool: MLATokenToKVPool,

@@ -1,9 +1,4 @@
-"""A host pool with its own page byte format namespaces its storage keys.
-
-The unified pool's host mirror stores whole page envelopes, whose bytes are
-token-major entries. A page persisted under another format has the same size,
-so only the key can keep it from being read back as a unified page: the
-storage model name carries the pool's format tag, and an untagged page misses.
+"""Storage keys separate host pools with incompatible page byte formats.
 
 CPU-only.
 
@@ -23,21 +18,24 @@
 
 from sglang.srt.managers.cache_controller import storage_model_name
 from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hicache_storage import HiCacheFile, HiCacheStorageConfig
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.memory_pool import MHATokenToKVPool, MLATokenToKVPool
 from sglang.srt.mem_cache.memory_pool_host import LogicalHostPool
 from sglang.srt.mem_cache.pool_host.base import HostKVCache
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.pool_host.mha import MHATokenToKVPoolHost
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.pool_host.mla import MLATokenToKVPoolHost
 from sglang.srt.mem_cache.pool_host.unified import UnifiedPageEnvelopeHostPool
 from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
 
 
-def _config(model_name):
+def _config(model_name, *, mla=False):
     return HiCacheStorageConfig(
         tp_rank=0,
         tp_size=1,
         pp_rank=0,
         pp_size=1,
         attn_cp_rank=0,
         attn_cp_size=1,
-        is_mla_model=False,
+        is_mla_model=mla,
         enable_storage_metrics=False,
         is_page_first_layout=True,
         model_name=model_name,
@@ -78,5 +76,90 @@ def test_untagged_page_misses_under_the_unified_name(self):
         self.assertFalse(tagged.exists("page-0"))
 
 
+class TestDenseStoragePageFormats(CustomTestCase):
+    def _host_pool(self, mla, layout):
+        device_type = MLATokenToKVPool if mla else MHATokenToKVPool
+        host_type = MLATokenToKVPoolHost if mla else MHATokenToKVPoolHost
+        geometry = (
+            dict(kv_lora_rank=2, qk_rope_head_dim=2)
+            if mla
+            else dict(head_num=2, head_dim=4)
+        )
+        device = device_type(
+            size=4,
+            page_size=2,
+            dtype=torch.float16,
+            layer_num=2,
+            device="cpu",
+            enable_memory_saver=False,
+            **geometry,
+        )
+        host = host_type(
+            device,
+            host_to_device_ratio=2,
+            host_size=0,
+            page_size=2,
+            layout=layout,
+            pin_memory=False,
+        )
+        self.addCleanup(host.destroy)
+        return host
+
+    def test_file_restore_requires_compatible_page_format(self):
+        for mla in (False, True):
+            layouts = ["layer_first", "page_first_direct", "page_first"]
+            if not mla:
+                layouts.append("page_head")
+            hosts = {layout: self._host_pool(mla, layout) for layout in layouts}
+            for source_layout, source in hosts.items():
+                with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+                    writer = HiCacheFile(
+                        _config(storage_model_name("org/model", source), mla=mla),
+                        file_path=directory,
+                    )
+                    payload = source.get_dummy_flat_data_page()
+                    payload.copy_(torch.arange(payload.numel()).reshape(payload.shape))
+                    source.set_from_flat_data_page(0, payload)
+                    self.assertTrue(writer.set("page-0", source.get_data_page(0)))
+                    for target_layout, target in hosts.items():
+                        with self.subTest(
+                            mla=mla, source=source_layout, target=target_layout
+                        ):
+                            reader = HiCacheFile(
+                                _config(
+                                    storage_model_name("org/model", target), mla=mla
+                                ),
+                                file_path=directory,
+                            )
+                            compatible = source_layout == target_layout or {
+                                source_layout,
+                                target_layout,
+                            } == {"layer_first", "page_first_direct"}
+                            self.assertEqual(reader.exists("page-0"), compatible)
+                            restored = reader.get(
+                                "page-0", target.get_dummy_flat_data_page()
+                            )
+                            if compatible:
+                                self.assertIsNotNone(restored)
+                                target.set_from_flat_data_page(0, restored)
+                                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                                    target.get_data_page(0), payload, rtol=0, atol=0
+                                )
+                            else:
+                                self.assertIsNone(restored)
+
+    def test_untagged_files_are_not_restored(self):
+        for mla in (False, True):
+            with self.subTest(mla=mla), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+                host = self._host_pool(mla, "layer_first")
+                legacy = HiCacheFile(_config("org/model", mla=mla), file_path=directory)
+                self.assertTrue(legacy.set("page-0", host.get_dummy_flat_data_page()))
+                tagged = HiCacheFile(
+                    _config(storage_model_name("org/model", host), mla=mla),
+                    file_path=directory,
+                )
+                self.assertFalse(tagged.exists("page-0"))
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
